import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 限时活动 - 道具余额查看
 * 指令：/活动道具
 */
import App from '@src/response-apps/limitedEvent/tokens/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { EVENT_FOOTER, EVENT_HEADER } from '@src/response/limitedEvent/nav';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  const result = await App({ uid, bid });

  if (result.code === 'LOAD_FAILED') {
    md.addText(result.data.message);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '活动道具', header: EVENT_HEADER, content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const tokens = result.data.tokens;

  if (!tokens.length) {
    md.addText('当前没有进行中的限时活动');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '活动道具', header: EVENT_HEADER, content: md }));

    return;
  }

  md.addText('🎒 活动道具余额');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();

  for (const t of tokens) {
    md.addText(`📌 ${t.eventTitle}`);
    md.addNewline();
    md.addBlockquote(
      Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${t.paidTokenName}（充值获得）：${t.paidToken}`).addNewline().addText(`${t.freeTokenName}（任务获得）：${t.freeToken}`)
    );
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '活动道具',
      header: EVENT_HEADER,
      content: md,
      footer: EVENT_FOOTER
    })
  );
});
